test_cases.title: Verify Controller Reports Proximal Tube Connection
steps: Initiate connection to the proximal tube via the controller API.
Assert that the controller API returns a connected status.
Check the system logs for a confirmation of the connection.
expected: The controller should report a connected status for the proximal tube.

test_cases.title: Verify Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm Activation
steps: Invoke the disconnect function on the controller.
Assert that the 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm is activated.
Check the alarm system for the 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm status.
expected: The 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm should be active.

test_cases.title: Verify Medium Priority of Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm
steps: Invoke the alarm priority function with 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm.
Assert that the alarm priority level is medium.
expected: The 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm should have a medium priority level.

test_cases.title: Verify Obstruction Alarm Activation When Obstruction Detected
steps: Invoke the obstruction alarm function.
Assert that the 'obstruction' alarm is activated.
Check the alarm system for the 'obstruction' alarm status.
expected: The 'obstruction' alarm should be active.

test_cases.title: Verify Obstruction Alarm Deactivation When No Obstruction Detected
steps: Invoke the obstruction alarm function.
Assert that the 'obstruction' alarm is not activated.
Check the alarm system for the 'obstruction' alarm status.
expected: The 'obstruction' alarm should not be active.

test_cases.title: Verify High Priority of Obstruction Alarm
steps: Invoke the alarm priority function with 'obstruction' alarm.
Assert that the alarm priority level is high.
expected: The 'obstruction' alarm should have a high priority level.

test_cases.title: Verify GUI Computation of Leakage Amount Based on Sensor Readings
steps: Invoke the leakage computation function with the provided sensor readings.
Assert that the function returns the correct leakage rate (L/min).
Check the GUI for the displayed leakage rate.
expected: The GUI should display the correct leakage rate based on the sensor readings.

test_cases.title: Boundary Test for Proximal Tube Disconnect Alarm Priority
steps: Invoke the alarm priority function with 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm.
Assert that the alarm priority is at its boundary condition (e.g., just below medium priority).
expected: The 'proximal tube disconnect' alarm should be at its boundary priority level.

test_cases.title: Boundary Test for Obstruction Alarm Priority
steps: Invoke the alarm priority function with 'obstruction' alarm.
Assert that the alarm priority is at its boundary condition (e.g., just below high priority).
expected: The 'obstruction' alarm should be at its boundary priority level.

test_cases.title: Negative Test Case for Non-Existent Alarm Priority
steps: Invoke the alarm priority function with 'proximal tube disconnect' and 'obstruction' alarms.
Assert that the system raises an exception for non-existent alarm priority.
expected: An exception should be raised for non-existent alarm priority.
